text.name: copy / introduction
text.text: Pick the features you want, then choose the buttons that open each one.

text.name: copy / planningNote
text.text: This is a configuration preview. You can save your choices now; a compatible firmware build and website upload are still in development.

text.name: Feature description
text.text: Play synth sounds from the pads and edit their parameters.

text.name: Feature description
text.text: Record an SP session on your computer, including screens, control changes and USB audio.

text.name: Feature description
text.text: Correct or shift the pitch of a monophonic input.

text.name: Build blocker
text.text: A selectable Synth build and configurable shortcut dispatcher have not been qualified.

text.name: copy / shortcutNote
text.text: Choose two or three physical SP controls. Hold the first controls, then press the last. Each shortcut opens its feature once; all controls must be released before it can open again.

text.name: copy / transferNote
text.text: You will be able to change this selection one feature at a time. The verified USB writer installs a complete APP1 firmware image, so a changed selection currently needs a newly composed image and a full update.

text.name: copy / transferLimit
text.text: Independent feature uploads and runtime hot swapping have not been verified. USB installation requires the matching writer, chip/profile checks, full flash readback, a separate status check and a real reboot.

text.name: Bridge qualification
text.text: USB BRIDGE B2 must already be installed and freshly identified. First installation from untouched stock over normal USB is unverified.

text.name: copy / footer
text.text: Feature configuration preview. No device connection.

text.name: copy / receiptNote
text.text: Choose a local JSON receipt to compare it with your current choices. Only metadata is checked; firmware files and device results remain unverified.

text.name: copy / receiptLimit
text.text: JSON, up to 128 KiB. This check does not connect to your SP.
